discription: A detuned saw wave with a resonant low-pass filter, controlled by an ADSR envelope for both amplitude and filter cutoff.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000, atk=0.01, dec=0.2, sus=0.7, rel=1.0; var sig, env, lpfEnv; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(atk, dec, sus, rel, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); lpfEnv = EnvGen.kr(Env.adsr(atk * 0.5, dec * 2, 0.5, rel * 0.5), gate: gate); sig = Saw.ar([freq, freq * 1.005]); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff * lpfEnv.linlin(0, 1, 0.1, 4), rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
